title: A client-attested cluster_tag cannot enforce the dev-build mainnet prohibition

Test the program-level boundary with a dev origin and deliberately non-mainnet cluster_tag.
rationale: adopted: WRD-ORG-01 statement + C1a task now rest the guarantee on origin binding (rp_id_hash pinned in deploy config), with the cluster_tag refusal explicitly labeled an honest-client guard — cluster_tag is caller-attested (transcript.rs:99-106)

title: Deploy attestation does not bind ProgramData authority to the audited Squads vault
reproducer_infeasible_reason: This is a future deployment/configuration attestation with no implementation or fixed SHA in the reviewed range; the counterexample follows from the two independently supplied identities.
suggested_fix: Add an upgrade-governance invariant. Pin the Squads program id and vault index, owner/discriminator-check and decode the multisig, derive its canonical vault PDA, and require ProgramData.upgrade_authority_address to equal that PDA. Add negative fixtures for an unrelated valid multisig, wrong vault index, wrong member count, spoofed owner/discriminator, and direct signer authority.
rationale: adopted (critical): Task 11R now derives the canonical Squads vault PDA from the decoded multisig and requires ProgramData.upgrade_authority == it, never accepting authority+multisig as independent facts; new WRD-DEP-01 + a single-key-authority-with-unrelated-multisig negative fixture

title: Task 11R can mark the deploy gate done while the Registry selector check remains a stub

suggested_fix: Add a deploy-selector invariant and implement live Registry decoding plus deterministic selector re-derivation/diffing in Task 11R. Add fixtures for missing, extra, wrong, and duplicate selectors and role-validator mismatches; prohibit Task 11 DONE until every numbered DEPLOY-GATE check is executable and green.
rationale: adopted: Task 11R scopes out DEPLOY-GATE check 3 (adapter-selector/Registry diff, WRD-DEP-02 — needs Task 3 registry + Task 5 selectors); Task 11 PARTIAL→DONE now requires BOTH 11R and WRD-DEP-02

title: The 3% quote check is not bound to one economic quantity
reproducer_infeasible_reason: The quote providers, approval flow, and fixed implementation do not exist in this range; this is a dimensional and request-binding defect in the newly added contract.
suggested_fix: Define a canonical QuoteIntent bound to approval id and exact message digest, account, cluster, mint pubkeys and decimals, swap mode, base-unit amount, slippage/fee convention, and route constraints. Bind both quotes to it; define 300-bps divergence with an explicit denominator, checked cross-multiplication, overflow bounds, and rounding direction; recreate the approval whenever a re-quote changes a bound field.
rationale: adopted: C4b defines a canonical QuoteIntent (approval id+digest, account, cluster, mints+decimals, mode, base-unit amount, convention), binds both quotes to it, and specifies the divergence denominator/rounding at 300 bps; WRD-QTE-01 updated

title: The wallet spec permits vanity onboarding before mandatory signature and decode prerequisites
reproducer_infeasible_reason: These client phases are plans only; no V4 integration or fixed SHA exists from which to construct the required base-red/fixed-green executable test.
suggested_fix: Make the spec and WRD-VAN-03 ledger note require C1a+C2a+C3+C4, and add a machine-checked dependency assertion so V4 cannot become complete while any prerequisite remains incomplete.
rationale: adopted: spec §6.1 and the WRD-VAN-03 note now require C1a+C2a+C3+C4 (matching the vanity plan), closing the spec-vs-plan inconsistency I introduced

title: The origin fix still tests post-creation mismatch instead of mainnet creation refusal
reproducer_infeasible_reason: Neither an extension nor a deployment-origin configuration exists, and no fixed SHA exists for a base-red/fixed-green executable pair. The future regression must submit a valid dev-origin create_account directly to a mainnet-configured program and require rejection.
suggested_fix: Name and implement an immutable or governed on-chain/deployment value for the permitted production rp_id_hash and require create_account to compare against it on mainnet. Make C1a acceptance include a direct dev-origin create transaction with an arbitrary attacker-chosen cluster_tag that fails at the program boundary; retain the A-versus-B test as a separate post-creation binding test.
rationale: adopted: C1a now names a program-enforced permitted production rp_id_hash (const or governed config) and a create_account mainnet-refusal, with a creation-REFUSAL red test (not a post-creation mismatch that passes even if creation accepts all origins)

title: Task 11R's fixture lane still does not prove the audited Squads identity
reproducer_infeasible_reason: Task 11R, its recorded-RPC fixtures, and a fixed SHA do not exist yet, so the required base-red/fixed-green execution cannot be run. Future negatives must independently mutate account owner/discriminator, vault index, and member count while keeping every other field valid.
suggested_fix: Make exact member_count == 5, Squads program owner and account discriminator, pinned vault index, and canonical PDA seed derivation explicit assertions. Add one valid-looking negative fixture for each omitted predicate, plus a fixture binding the Warden Program account to the owner-checked ProgramData account; promote WRD-DEP-01 only when all fail through the production parsing path.
rationale: adopted (critical): Task 11R fixtures now force explicit owner/discriminator/member_count==5/vault-index/canonical-PDA assertions, each with a valid-looking negative fixture a lazy checker would fail

title: ExactOut quotes always agree under the output-only divergence rule
reproducer_infeasible_reason: No quote implementation or fixed SHA exists. A future fixture must hold ExactOut output constant, vary required input beyond 300 bps, and be red before the mode-specific fix and green after it.
suggested_fix: Define the compared adverse quantity by mode: net output after all fees for ExactIn and total required input after all fees for ExactOut. Pin the denominator, checked integer cross-multiplication, overflow bounds, and conservative rounding direction, and add below/at/above-300-bps fixtures for both modes, including constant-output/divergent-input ExactOut quotes.
rationale: adopted: the divergence-checked adverse quantity is mode-dependent — net output after fees for ExactIn, total required input after fees for ExactOut — with a required ExactOut fixture; output-only would render agreement for an adverse ExactOut input quote

title: Extension-id equality does not distinguish UI pages from content scripts

suggested_fix: Authorize each privileged UI surface only when sender.id equals chrome.runtime.id and browser-owned sender.url/origin has the exact chrome-extension://<id> origin and an allowed extension page path. Treat http(s), opaque, missing, and content-script page/frame origins as provider context regardless of port name. Test with a real content script carrying the same extension id, including top-frame and iframe cases.
rationale: adopted: WRD-EXT-02 and C1 now require sender.id==runtime.id AND the exact chrome-extension origin at an allowed page path; an extension content script shares sender.id and can runtime.connect (Chrome docs)

title: Rolled-back debits can emit indistinguishable success events
reproducer_infeasible_reason: Task 5 execute/swap events and the notifier do not exist, and there is no fixed SHA. A future regression must capture a first debit event followed by a later transaction failure and verify that the notifier records no committed debit.
suggested_fix: Define event outcome semantics at the notifier boundary: process BucketDebited and freeze-transition events only from finalized transactions with meta.err == null, while classifying CapRejected as a failed-attempt diagnostic. Include signature/slot/instruction-index idempotence. Add multi-mint and later-top-level-failure fixtures that retain logs but must not count a committed debit, plus a successful control counted exactly once.
rationale: adopted: WRD-EVT-01 pins notifier-boundary semantics — BucketDebited/freeze counted only from finalized meta.err==null tx; a rolled-back debit's surviving log is not a spend

title: Canonical PDA derivation still starts from an unpinned governance identity
reproducer_infeasible_reason: Task 11R, its RPC fixtures, and a fixed implementation SHA do not exist. Future fixtures must substitute a structurally valid but unauthorized Squads multisig and a ProgramData account not bound from the Warden Program account.
suggested_fix: Pin the Warden program id and mainnet Squads multisig pubkey in versioned, reviewed deployment configuration rather than accepting either as unchecked CLI identity. Attest the expected member pubkeys/permissions or an explicitly approved governance snapshot, follow and owner-check the Program account's canonical ProgramData address, then derive the configured multisig's vault. Add substitution fixtures for an unauthorized but structurally valid 3-of-5 multisig and an unrelated ProgramData account.
rationale: adopted (critical, r3): WRD-DEP-01 + Task 11R now pin the expected mainnet Squads multisig pubkey AND member-pubkey set from versioned reviewed config, not just structural properties; a well-formed attacker multisig (right threshold/lock, wrong identity) is a required negative fixture

title: The 300-bps rule still has two opposite boundary outcomes
reproducer_infeasible_reason: No quote implementation or fixed SHA exists in this range. A future base-red/fixed-green fixture should encode the same quote pair under each candidate denominator and assert one pinned outcome at, below, and above 300 bps.
suggested_fix: State one exact checked-integer predicate, including which quote supplies the denominator, zero handling, intermediate width, rounding direction, and strict boundary. Add independent ExactIn and ExactOut fixtures immediately below, exactly at, and immediately above 300 bps; expected outcomes must not be generated by the implementation under test.
rationale: adopted (r3): pinned ONE exact predicate — abs_diff(p,c)*10000 > 300*p in u128, primary as denominator, strict >, p==0 VOID; worked boundary fixtures corrected (my first example was self-inconsistent)

title: Keyring AAD omits the network domain
reproducer_infeasible_reason: The production extension and envelope parser do not exist, so there is no fixed SHA for a runnable red/green vector. The future vector should transplant one valid envelope between two cluster/program contexts sharing the other AAD fields.

Add wrong-cluster, same-address and wrong-program replay vectors, with an explicit migration for existing envelopes.
rationale: adopted: WRD-KEY-04 AAD now binds genesis hash + Warden program id; a SmartAccount PDA is not network-qualified so an envelope would otherwise transplant across clusters undetected

title: Non-exportability claims contradict supported synced passkeys
reproducer_infeasible_reason: Authenticator backup and sync occur outside this repository, and no production credential policy exists yet. A repository test cannot prove global non-exportability; future policy tests can only enforce and observe backup-eligibility/state requirements.
suggested_fix: Narrow WRD-KEY-01 and WRD-EXP-01 to the enforceable application boundary: no Warden/extension root-export API and root material never enters extension memory. If global device-bound non-exportability is required, resolve the T7 decision and enforce a credential policy that rejects backup-eligible credentials, with BE/BS handling and real-device evidence; authenticatorAttachment alone is not that proof.
rationale: adopted (minor): WRD-KEY-01/WRD-EXP-01 narrowed from 'non-exportable' to Warden's enforceable boundary (no export API, root never in extension memory); a backup-eligible synced passkey is movable by the platform (WebAuthn L3/FIDO) and is the T7 threat, not a Warden guarantee

title: Task 11R still accepts single-key-controlled Squads governance
reproducer_infeasible_reason: Task 11R and its fixture harness do not exist at either reviewed SHA, so no executable red-at-base/green-at-fixed pair can be run. The future negative fixture is a valid recorded RPC state with the pinned multisig and member keys, threshold 3, timeLock 604800, the derived vault as ProgramData authority, and an attacker-controlled non-default configAuthority; a fixed gate must reject it.
suggested_fix: Require configAuthority == Pubkey::default() for the pinned autonomous multisig, or pin and attest an explicitly approved authority with equivalent independently enforced governance. Pin full member records including permissions. Fetch the pinned executable Warden Program account, verify Upgradeable Loader ownership/state, follow its encoded ProgramData address, owner-check and decode that exact account, then test the authority and hash. Add valid-looking negative fixtures for non-default configAuthority, altered member permissions, and unrelated ProgramData.
rationale: adopted (critical, r4): WRD-DEP-01 + Task 11R now assert Multisig.configAuthority == Pubkey::default() (autonomous), closing the last Squads-governance layer — a non-default config authority is a single key that can reconfigure a pinned 3-of-5; negative fixture added

title: The new threat row restores the synced-passkey non-exportability overclaim
reproducer_infeasible_reason: Authenticator backup and sync occur outside this repository, no production credential policy exists, and no fixed SHA exists for a red/green pair. Repository tests can enforce Warden's API and BE/BS policy, but cannot prove global platform non-exportability.
suggested_fix: Rewrite C-11 to say Warden exposes no root/session export API, root material never enters extension memory, and recovery reveal/export requires fresh authentication. State that platform passkey backup/sync remains T7. If device-bound roots are required, resolve T7 and specify/test BE/BS rejection with real-device evidence rather than claiming it from application code.
rationale: adopted: appended a THREATMODEL correction removing the C-11 'never exportable' overclaim to match the round-3 WRD-KEY-01/EXP-01 narrowing (append-only file)

title: The vanity threat row specifies a different salt construction than the implementation plan
reproducer_infeasible_reason: This range adds contradictory documentation but no vanity worker and no fixed SHA, so a base-red/fixed-green executable pair does not exist. A future consistency test can pin the corrected nonce/counter construction and reject counter wrap, nonce reuse, and CSPRNG failure.
suggested_fix: Change V-4 to the actual contract: a 192-bit CSPRNG job nonce concatenated with a disjoint u64 counter; CSPRNG failure, nonce reuse, and counter wrap reject. Tighten WRD-VAN-01 or add a separate invariant and independent vectors for those properties without replacing the working lane construction.
rationale: adopted: appended a THREATMODEL correction — the V-4 salt is job_nonce24||counter64_le (192-bit CSPRNG + disjoint counter), not a full 32-byte random; WRD-VAN-01 note aligned to the vanity plan

title: Deploy gate still does not authenticate Warden's canonical ProgramData
reproducer_infeasible_reason: Task 11R, its RPC parser, and its fixture harness do not exist at either reviewed SHA, and no fixed SHA exists. The future negative fixture must make pinned Program P point to canonical ProgramData A with an attacker authority while also supplying unrelated, loader-owned ProgramData B with the approved Squads-vault authority; the vulnerable gate accepts B and the fixed gate derives/follows P to A and rejects.
suggested_fix: Extend WRD-DEP-01 and Task 11R to fetch the pinned executable Warden Program account, require BPF Upgradeable Loader ownership and Program state, derive the loader canonical ProgramData PDA and require it to match the encoded address, then require loader ownership and ProgramData state on that exact account before checking authority and code. Add valid-looking fixtures for an unrelated ProgramData account, wrong loader owner/state, and an encoded/derived ProgramData mismatch.
rationale: adopted (critical, r5): Task 11R/WRD-DEP-01 now authenticate Warden's canonical ProgramData (pinned Program account -> BPF loader owner + Program state -> encoded ProgramData address -> decode), closing the last link — an unnamed ProgramData whose authority is the vault is no longer accepted; negative fixtures added

title: Recovery-envelope AAD still omits the network domain
reproducer_infeasible_reason: No production extension, recovery-envelope parser, or fixed SHA exists, so a red-at-base/green-at-fixed executable pair cannot be run. The future vector must import one valid recovery envelope under two cluster/program contexts that share the account pubkey and show that the legacy account || version AAD authenticates in both while the versioned context-bound envelope rejects the wrong context.
suggested_fix: Version the recovery-envelope format through the explicit migration C5 already requires and canonically bind at least account, genesis hash, Warden program id, recovery-key kind, and schema version. If cross-network import is intentional, require an explicit authenticated decrypt-and-re-encrypt migration rather than accepting the original envelope silently. Add wrong-cluster/same-address and wrong-program vectors and enumerate these fields in WRD-EXP-01.
rationale: adopted: the recovery envelope's AAD (C5, spec §7, WRD-EXP-01) now binds genesis + program id + recovery-key context, matching WRD-KEY-04; the threshold-weight bearer envelope no longer authenticates after cross-cluster transplant

title: The deploy gate does not attest the code and role map controlling the Squads vault
reproducer_infeasible_reason: Task 11R's RPC parser and fixture harness do not exist at either reviewed SHA, and the Squads program's live immutability/upgrade configuration is an external release attestation. Future fixtures can keep every currently checked Warden and multisig field fixed while changing the Squads ProgramData hash/authority or member permission masks.
suggested_fix: Extend WRD-DEP-01 and Task 11R to authenticate the pinned Squads Program account and its canonical ProgramData, pin the audited deployed code hash, and require the Squads program to be immutable or recursively attest an explicitly approved upgrade authority with an adequate timelock and monitoring boundary. Pin the exact sorted Member { key, permissions.mask } records, not only keys. Add valid-looking negative fixtures for altered Squads code/hash, mutable or substituted Squads ProgramData authority, and unchanged keys with altered permission masks.
rationale: adopted (critical, r6): added Squads-program code authentication + audited-code-hash pin, and explicitly terminated the trust root there (Squads governance = documented external assumption in THREATMODEL). This closes the 6-round WRDF-0017 chain: Warden ProgramData auth -> vault PDA -> multisig identity/members/threshold/timelock/configAuthority -> Squads code hash -> documented terminus

title: WRD-ORG-01 compares an origin string with a SHA-256 digest
reproducer_infeasible_reason: This is a malformed ledger/test contract rather than a defect in the existing verifier, which already performs the two correctly typed comparisons. No fixed SHA exists; a future ledger-consistency test can pin the corrected field relationships.
suggested_fix: State three typed relationships explicitly: creation requires stored origin == the permitted production origin and stored rp_id_hash == SHA256(stored origin); assertion verification requires clientDataJSON.origin == stored origin and authenticatorData.rpIdHash == stored rp_id_hash. Give the creation-refusal and both assertion comparisons independent negative tests.
rationale: adopted: WRD-ORG-01 restated with typed comparisons (origin and rp_id_hash are separate stored fields per root_verify/mod.rs:211-221) — no longer compares an origin string with a SHA-256 digest

title: The notifier contract still lacks replay-safe event identity
reproducer_infeasible_reason: Neither the notifier nor its ingestion harness exists, and there is no fixed SHA. A future deterministic test should deliver one finalized successful event twice and require one count, while delivering two byte-identical events at distinct instruction/log ordinals and requiring two counts.
suggested_fix: Define and persist an event identity based on transaction signature plus outer/inner instruction and event/log ordinal, with explicit finalized/restart behavior. Test duplicate delivery across reconnect/restart, and separately prove that distinct byte-identical events in one transaction are both retained.
rationale: adopted (minor, r6): event identity is (tx signature, instruction index, event ordinal), persisted — a reconnect/backfill/restart cannot double-count a legitimate repeated debit; payload dedup would wrongly merge two real identical debits

title: Deploy attestation still omits Squads member permission masks
reproducer_infeasible_reason: Task 11R, its recorded-RPC fixtures, and a fixed SHA do not yet exist. A future regression can hold keys, threshold, timelock, authority, and code hashes constant while changing one permissions.mask, then require the fixed gate to reject.
suggested_fix: Pin and compare the exact sorted Member { key, permissions.mask } records, assert the intended voter/proposer/executor sets and known-bit mask, and add a valid-looking fixture with unchanged keys, threshold, timelock, and hashes but one altered mask.
rationale: adopted (critical, r7): added per-member permission-mask attestation; WRD-DEP-01 now requires the COMPLETE audited Squads config and explicitly scopes the byte-level field inventory to Task 11R implementation against the pinned IDL — closing the pre-spec 'one more field' regress

title: A stale pre-approved Squads vault transaction survives the governance attestation
reproducer_infeasible_reason: The deployment gate and a fixed SHA do not exist yet. A future deterministic fixture can supply a perfect current multisig plus an Approved stale vault transaction targeting Warden ProgramData; the vulnerable specification accepts the snapshot and the fixed gate must reject it.

suggested_fix: Dispatch role validation on the (program_id, selector) pair or encode the authority/source positions in RegistryEntry. rationale: The default entry assigns ROLE_VAULT_SIGNER to the eight-byte Anchor sighash for test-mutator::transfer_out. registry_allows passes only the selector to spl_authority_index; only one-byte SPL tags 3 and 12 receive explicit authority positions, so this eight-byte selector takes the fallback that requires the vault PDA at accounts[0]. The mutator's actual Anchor layout is [source, destination, authority, token_program], with the vault PDA at accounts[2] and its token account at accounts[0]. The honest layout therefore fails the Registry before the mutator runs; moving the PDA to index 0 makes the mutator feed a non-token PDA to SPL Token. Consequently this canonical test adapter cannot reach the handler or conservation layer and can invalidate Task 5's real-CPI assurance lane.
